correctness.rationale: Finite exact recurrence partitions all matchings by least unmatched vertex and by an independent minimum-branching C++ search, both produce 60; complementary degree-two cycle tracing gives 42 of (24), 6 of (12,12), 12 of (8,8,8). Complete distance-automorphism backtracking gives exactly 32, and its action partitions 60 matchings into eight orbits. The attached files and two successful executions were inspected; no finite sampling is extrapolated to an infinite result. The proper edge-coloring count follows by 2^c alternations on each even cycle.

value.rationale: For a canonical smallest cubic girth-seven graph, the full natural 2-factor cycle-type spectrum supplies the total Hamiltonian count, exact non-Hamiltonian configurations, a uniform mod-4 cycle-length obstruction, complete symmetry classification and proper three-edge-coloring count. These quantities are not recoverable from the known existence of a Hamiltonian cycle or the scalar graph invariants. It is a motivated complete classification of a natural factorization invariant; no arbitrary parameter slice is needed.
